headword: {通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}
gloss: passbook update; printing transactions in a bankbook

definitions.gloss: passbook update; printing transactions in a bankbook
definitions.explanation: Having recent deposits, withdrawals, and the running balance printed into a bank passbook. Typically done at an ATM, which has a dedicated slot for feeding in the passbook.

examples.japanese: ATM⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To update the passbook at an ATM.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: When I updated my passbook after a long time, a lot of entries came out at once.

examples.japanese: {通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ATM⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Passbook updates can be done free of charge at dedicated ATMs, not at the counter.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{通帳|つうちょう}→通帳：09924_tsuuchou⟧ (passbook) and ⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧ (filling in, entering). The label appears on Japanese ATM menus and is a routine banking task. When too many transactions have accumulated while the passbook was not updated, the ATM may print a summary line instead of every transaction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to update the passbook
- {通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to finish updating the passbook
- {通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧: dedicated passbook-update machine
- {未記帳|みきちょう}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通帳記入|つうちょうきにゅう}: updating with not-yet-printed transactions

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{通帳|つうちょう}→通帳：09924_tsuuchou⟧: passbook — the booklet being updated
- ⟦{記帳|きちょう}→記帳：18809_kichou⟧: bookkeeping; making an entry in a book — a near-synonym that also appears on ATM menus as ⟦{記帳|きちょう}→記帳：18809_kichou⟧
- ⟦{預金通帳|よきんつうちょう}→預金通帳：23587_yokintsuuchou⟧: bank passbook — the more formal full form
